d:
Phon taiping ke mudde par bihar ki rajniti men bhi bayanbaji tej ho gaee hai. jan suraj ke sansthapak prashant kishor ne kangres neta rahul gandhi ke phon taiping vale dave ka samarthan karte hue kaha ki unka phon bhi taip hota hai. prashant kishor ke is bayan ke bad rajnitik galiyaron men charcha tej ho gaee hai. aakhir phon taiping ko lekar prashant kishor ne kya kuchh kaha? dekhie yah riport.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
